subject: Next steps — 30-min product intro + technical deep-dive options
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@aurorasoft.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Sep 2028 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Quick follow-up + 30-min intro slots (post-discovery)
Attachments: RI-Intro-1pager.pdf (one-page overview)

Hi Lena — thanks again for the conversation this morning. Quick recap and next steps so we keep momentum: 

- What we heard: AuroraSoft is evaluating a low-latency inference layer for customer-facing summarization (priority) and an internal indexing/embedding pipeline (secondary). Key constraints: SSO/SAML, data retention controls, and predictable latency under concurrent traffic.

- Next recommended step: a 30-minute product intro focused on the user experience + integration pattern, followed by an optional 45-minute technical deep-dive that includes infra and SRE.

Proposed slots (pick 1 preferred; we’ll hold the others for 48 hrs):
1) Tue Sep 19 — 11:00–11:30am PT (30m intro)
2) Wed Sep 20 — 9:30–10:00am PT (30m intro)
3) Thu Sep 21 — 2:00–2:45pm PT (45m technical deep-dive / backup)

Suggested attendees: Product lead, Engineering/Infra owner (for the 45m), one SME from security for the SSO discussion. I’ve cc’d Soojin from our security/solutions team — she can address SSO and data controls directly.

I attached a one-pager that highlights deployment modes (hosted, dedicated, private) and a short checklist for the deep-dive so your infra team knows what to expect. If it helps, here’s a Calendly link to pick a time directly: https://calendly.com/redwood/30min-intro

Would you prefer we lock one of the 30-minute slots first and then schedule the deep-dive separately, or hold the 45-minute slot now as a single session?

Thanks — looking forward to continuing the conversation.

—Jonas
Jonas Weber
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
redwoodinference.com

Hi Jonas — thanks for the clear recap. Appreciate the one-pager — that’s helpful to share with the team.

We’re keen to move forward. Prefer option 2 (Wed Sep 20, 9:30–10:00am PT) for the 30-minute intro — that time looks clean for Product and me. Marcus (cc’d) will join the deep-dive if we schedule one; he’s our infra lead.

Quick Q: can Soojin cover SSO (SAML) + data retention (we’re particularly interested in retention windows and audit logging)? If Soojin can join the 30-min, we can do a short triage there and then decide whether to take the 45-min technical session.

Also, if you need to share any pre-read for Marcus ahead of the deep-dive (networking/VPC checklist), please send it and we’ll circulate.

I’ll tentatively accept Wed 9:30am and confirm once Marcus gives the green light — cc’ing him to confirm his availability for the deeper session.

Best,
